legend: Macroscopic appearance of a chondroid lipoma in the thigh of a 74-year-old woman. Lesion is circumscribed and consists of fat interspersed by glistening grey septa and multifocal haemorrhage.

Corresponding MRI coronal short-tau inversion recovery (STIR) image showing heterogeneously enhancing lipomatous soft tissue mass in the adductor musculature of the right mid thigh, measuring 68 mm (craniocaudal) × 50 mm (transverse) × 51 mm (anteroposterior).

FNA from a posterior mediastinal mass in a 23-year-old woman. Note a cluster of cells with nuclear scalloping by lipid droplets in a lipoblast (arrow) that is surrounded by multiple mononuclear cells without apparent lipoblastic differentiation. Note the myxoid matrix. Diff-Quik stain.

A Partial karyotype and schematic illustrating the characteristic 11;16 translocation. B Schematic of ZFTA and MRTFB showing corresponding breakpoints associated with the ZFTA::MRTFB fusion gene. C Nucleotide and amino acid sequences around the fusion point are presented. D The coding region of the fusion cDNA demonstrating the boundaries of exons and the position of conserved domains.
FNA of a mass in masticator space showing lipoblasts and undifferentiated cellular component with variably lobulated nuclei, bland chromatin, and intranuclear cytoplasmic inclusions. Pap.
